Description: Discovered a potential authorization token provided in a curl command header, which could compromise the curl accessed resource.
Author: Brad Wilcox
Message:
chore: mirror HubSpot developer docs in resources/hubspot/ (#1)

Adds scraped reference docs for the three HubSpot topics needed for
the onboarding workflow: MCP auth app setup, legacy private apps, and
the CRM Properties API (with curl examples for creating the two
required deal properties).

Key finding: private apps are now "Legacy" in HubSpot's new platform.
MCP auth apps (OAuth + PKCE via mcp.hubspot.com) are the preferred
pattern for AI/Claude integrations going forward.

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Author: Brad Wilcox
Message:
chore: add .env.example and commit service-keys docs (#2)

Adds .env.example with HUBSPOT_SERVICE_KEY placeholder and instructions
for locating the token in HubSpot. Adds .gitignore to exclude real .env.
Also commits the previously-written service-keys.md reference doc and
updates resources/hubspot/README.md to reflect Service Keys as the
recommended auth path (over legacy private apps).
